subject: Beta Fintech MAP kickoff & weekly checkpoints — success criteria alignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Huang <jill.huang@beta-fintech.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@beta-fintech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Beta Fintech MAP kickoff & weekly checkpoints — success criteria alignment

Hi Jill / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time on the demo last week. As discussed, I’ve attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a proposed evaluation plan to get us started. I’d like to kick off a short weekly checkpoint cadence to keep the path to close predictable and surface risks early.

Proposed cadence and scope:
- Weekly 30-minute checkpoint (Mon or Tue) — status, blockers, next actions
- Owners assigned for each MAP line item (see attached MAP_BetaFintech_v1.xlsx)
- Evaluation milestones: smoke tests (week 2), performance validation (week 4), security review complete (week 6)

Success criteria we should agree on now (suggested):
1) Prod-ish performance: avg token latency < 120ms on 8k context for P1 flows
2) Cost target: projected 25% improvement vs current provider at target throughput
3) Security: SOC2 evidence and VPC peering signoff by security team

Can you confirm the right stakeholders on your side for SRE/perf and procurement? Also — are Tue mornings (09:00–09:30 PT) workable for a standing checkpoint?

Next steps on our side: attach initial MAP (owner assignments), evaluation plan (metrics & artifacts), and a link to the demo recording.

Attachments: MAP_BetaFintech_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), beta-eval-plan-v1.md (evaluation plan), redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (20min)

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Jill Huang <jill.huang@beta-fintech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@beta-fintech.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Beta Fintech MAP kickoff & weekly checkpoints — success criteria alignment

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Quick answers from our side:
- SRE/Perf: Carlos will lead technical validation; he’s cc’d.
- Procurement: procurement@beta-fintech.com is the queue; I’ll loop in the contract owner once we hit the security checklist.
- Standing time: Tue 09:00 PT works for us starting next week (Mar 24).

We reviewed the success criteria and the latency target looks aggressive but fair; Carlos will validate feasibility against our traffic profile. For cost targets, we prefer to baseline on the 95th percentile throughput over a 24h window — happy to share a sample trace.

I’ll share the internal stakeholders by EOD. For the MAP, a couple of asks: can we add an acceptance criterion for the UX/regression tests (P0 flows) and a rollback trigger tied to error rate?

—Jill
VP Product, Beta Fintech
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@beta-fintech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jill Huang <jill.huang@beta-fintech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 04:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Beta Fintech MAP kickoff & weekly checkpoints — success criteria alignment

Karthik / team —

I dug into the demo notes. I can take point for the perf run and will need:
- A sample inference endpoint URL and token for a non-prod workspace (prefer short-lived token)
- Guidance on expected payload sizes and typical sequence lengths for the P1 flow
- An initial test plan template (we can use the evaluation plan you attached)

I’m fine with Tue 09:00 PT weekly. Can you schedule the recurring invite and include the MAP as a living doc? Also, please add a clear owner for security evidence collection — that’s been a common stall point for us in past projects.

Carlos
Sr. SRE, Beta Fintech
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@beta-fintech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jill Huang <jill.huang@beta-fintech.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Beta Fintech MAP kickoff & weekly checkpoints — success criteria alignment

Great — I’ll own security evidence collection on the Redwood side and be the primary for SOC2 artifacts and network checklist items.

Carlos — I’ll send a short-lived test token and non-prod endpoint details by EOD. Also attaching a one-page test plan template we often use for perf smoke runs (attached: perf-smoke-template.md).

Karthik — can you create the recurring calendar invite for Tue 09:00 PT starting Mar 24 and mark the agenda: 1) blockers (10m), 2) evaluation progress (10m), 3) action items & owners (10m). I’ll make sure the MAP spreadsheet is the shared source of truth.

Lauren
Head of Security Integrations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Huang <jill.huang@beta-fintech.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@beta-fintech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@beta-fintech.com
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 10:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Beta Fintech MAP kickoff & weekly checkpoints — success criteria alignment

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Quick notes and action items from this kickoff thread: 

ACTION ITEMS (owner / due):
- Schedule recurring checkpoint invite (Karthik) — due: 2026-03-20 (INVITE SENT)
- Provide non-prod endpoint + short-lived token (Lauren) — due: 2026-03-19 (SENT)
- Perf smoke test (Carlos) — due: 2026-03-31 (Carlos to share results)
- Add UX/regression acceptance criteria + rollback trigger (Jill) — due: 2026-03-22
- Security evidence: collect SOC2 snapshot & network peering checklist (Lauren) — due: 2026-04-02
- Procurement: initial contract outline & billing questions (procurement@beta-fintech.com) — target: 2026-04-09

Links / artifacts: MAP_BetaFintech_v1.xlsx (owner columns filled), beta-eval-plan-v1.md (test metrics), demo recording: https://drive.google.com/file/d/abc123-demo

Let me know if I missed anything. I’ll post a short meeting note after next week’s checkpoint.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting the first eval run going.

Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
